parole.significato: Originally, a chief minister under the Marathi princes; later, (the title of) each of the rulers of the Marathi kingdom…
parole.testo: Borrowed from Marathi पेशवा (peśvā), from Classical Persian پیشوا (pēšwā).

parole.significato: A visual art form from Maharashtra, India, involving singing and dancing.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Marathi तमाशा (tamāśā), from Classical Persian تماشا (tamāšā), ultimately from Arabic مَشَى (mašā, “to walk”).
